lines.text: One rolls again; the other becomes crumb.
lines.phonemes: wˈʌn ɹˈoʊlz ɐɡˈɛn; ðɪ ˈʌðɚ bɪkˌʌmz kɹˈʌm.

lines.text: India retreads about ten million tyres a year.
lines.tts: India retreads about ten million tires a year.
lines.phonemes: ˈɪndiɚ ɹᵻtɹˈɛdz ɐbˌaʊt tˈɛn mˈɪliən tˈaɪɚz ɐ jˈɪɹ.

lines.text: Retreaders need a sound casing: no cuts or separations.
lines.phonemes: ɹᵻtɹˈɛdɚz nˈiːd ɐ sˈaʊnd kˈeɪsɪŋ: nˈoʊ kˈʌts ɔːɹ sˌɛpɚɹˈeɪʃənz.

lines.text: So inspect each tyre, and sort casings from crumb tyres.
lines.tts: So inspect each tire, and sort casings from crumb tires.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ ɪnspˈɛkt ˈiːtʃ tˈaɪɚ, ænd sˈɔːɹt kˈeɪsɪŋz fɹʌm kɹˈʌm tˈaɪɚz.

lines.text: Say ten tyres give six casings: after buying, sorting and transport, about ₹1,300 is left.
lines.tts: Say ten tires give six casings: after buying, sorting and transport, about thirteen hundred rupees is left.
lines.phonemes: sˈeɪ tˈɛn tˈaɪɚz ɡˈɪv sˈɪks kˈeɪsɪŋz: ˈæftɚ bˈaɪɪŋ, sˈɔːɹɾɪŋ ænd tɹˈænspɔːɹt, ɐbˌaʊt θˈɜːtiːn hˈʌndɹɪd ɹˈuːpiːz ɪz lˈɛft.

lines.text: Sold all as crumb, the same ten lose money.
lines.phonemes: sˈoʊld ˈɔːl æz kɹˈʌm, ðə sˈeɪm tˈɛn lˈuːz mˈʌni.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
